title: 上海高考高分翻译背诵-127-25二模

items.zh: 社区卫生中心的入口便于轮椅进出。
items.en: The community health center provides easy access for wheelchairs at its entrance.

items.zh: 一些技术突破并非由科技巨头们推动,而是来自普通人的奇思妙想。
items.en: Rather than being driven by tech giants, some technological breakthroughs emerge from the ingenuity of ordinary people.

items.zh: 那个城市缺少可供居民消磨时间的公园,在旧城改造时应相应地增加绿色空间。
items.en: The city lacks parks for residents to while away the time, so some green space should be created accordingly during the old city renovation.

items.zh: 无论雨天还是晴天;每周四的校园露天音乐会都会吸引大批学生观众,使之成为校园生活一道亮丽的风景线。
items.en: Rainy or sunny, the open-air campus concert every Thursday attracts large crowds of students, which makes it quite a sight in campus life.
